word-cashier.def: a person who takes payment from customers in a store

word-checkout.def: the place in a store where customers pay for what they buy

word-shopping-cart.def: a metal basket on wheels that customers push around a supermarket

word-plastic-bag.def: a thin container made of synthetic material for carrying groceries

word-price-tag.def: a small label that shows how much something costs

word-refund.def: money that a store gives back to you when you bring something back

word-return-goods.def: to bring something you bought back to a store, usually to get your money back

word-warranty.def: a written promise that a company will repair or replace a product if it breaks

word-fitting-room.def: a small room in a store where you try on clothes

word-shop-window.def: the large glass front of a business where goods are shown to people outside

word-opening-hours.def: the times of day when a store or office is open to customers

word-department-store.def: a large shop with separate sections selling clothes, furniture and many other things

word-kiosk.def: a very small stand or booth on the street that sells newspapers, snacks or tickets

word-flea-market.def: an outdoor market where people sell used goods and old things cheaply

word-florist.def: a person or shop that sells cut flowers and plants

word-delivery.def: the act of bringing goods or mail to a person's home or workplace

word-shorts.def: short pants that end above the knee

word-necktie.def: a long strip of cloth worn around the collar and knotted at the front

word-cap.def: a soft hat with a stiff brim at the front

word-swimsuit.def: an outfit that you wear when you go swimming

word-pajamas.def: loose clothes that people wear in bed

word-slippers.def: soft, light shoes that you wear indoors

word-sandals.def: light open shoes with straps, worn in warm weather

word-bra.def: a piece of women's underwear that supports the breasts

word-jeans.def: casual pants made of strong blue cloth called denim

word-blouse.def: a light shirt for women, often with buttons

word-sleeve.def: the part of a shirt or coat that covers your arm

word-zipper.def: a fastener with two rows of teeth that you close by pulling a small tab

word-cotton.def: soft cloth or thread made from the white fibers of a plant

word-wool.def: soft thick material made from the hair of sheep, used for warm clothes

word-silk.def: smooth, shiny cloth made from the fine thread of a certain caterpillar

word-sunglasses.def: dark glasses that protect your eyes from bright light

word-perfume.def: a liquid with a pleasant smell that people put on their skin

word-cosmetics.def: products that people put on their face or skin to look better

word-medium-size.def: a clothing size between small and large

word-vyshyvanka.gl: vyshyvanka: Ukrainian shirt with traditional embroidery, a national symbol
